pull_request.title: Adopt validated Cargo dependency-boundary metadata
pull_request.body:
Adopt the committed Shared Tooling 0.20.0 dependency-boundary checker at `3f87ddc1a0c1616775b2114c42a4adee7376c9b1`. The checker now refuses failed Cargo observations and incomplete/mismatched workspace metadata before reporting success, closing the false acceptance described in #4.

The canonical exporter generated the three-file bundle in a scratch Git root; it was copied intact to `tools/dependency-boundaries/`. The root tooling snapshot, consumer policy and Make target are unchanged. Notes target contributor-only 0.3.2; package versions, dependency selection, published library behavior and stored formats are unchanged.

Validation on Linux: the actual `make check-storage-boundary` passes, deliberately disallowing the substrate rejects `ic-storage -> ic-stable-structures`, and the original policy is restored byte-for-byte. Both snapshots, documentation links, selected ShellCheck and diff checks pass. No product compilation, dependency fetch, full workspace/MSRV gate or native macOS run was performed; required hosted qualification remains enabled.

Closes #4.

issue.title: Add declarative Cargo dependency boundaries

repository.name: shared-tooling
repository.description: Reusable development tools, CI building blocks, workflows, and documentation for Dragginz Game repositories

issue.body:
## Current delivered-source acceptance

Delivered on main at `3f87ddc1a0c1616775b2114c42a4adee7376c9b1` (Shared 0.20.0). The [exact-source CI matrix](https://github.com/dragginzgame/shared-tooling/actions/runs/39019838115) is complete and successful: change-scope, lint/security, Linux, native macOS ARM and native macOS Intel. The Cargo dependency-boundary checker and later complete-metadata/normal-child-exit admission are already delivered on main. This contribution is superseded by that delivery; closing the PR without merging it. Storage adoption remains in #4 / PR #6: https://github.com/dragginzgame/ic-storage/issues/4 and https://github.com/dragginzgame/ic-storage/pull/6; that PR is not merged.

Earlier failed/cancelled runs retain their actual outcomes; no release, merge or consumer acceptance is inferred.

---

## Historical preparation and proposal

IC Storage currently carries a local Cargo metadata parser to prohibit direct substrate dependencies outside its infrastructure library. Add an opt-in shared checker with consumer-owned dependency/allowed-package rules so repositories can enforce that boundary without copying implementation.

Checks canonical Cargo package names (including renamed, target-specific and development dependencies), rejects malformed policy, and uses locked offline metadata. Consumer adoption uses a revision-pinned snapshot; no fleet policy is imposed.

Validation: focused fixtures cover allowed/forbidden ownership, renamed target-specific dev dependencies, duplicate/malformed rules and unrelated dependencies; ShellCheck passes. The canonical exporter successfully exports the helper and its integrity companions. Full release validation was not run.

issue.title: Adopt fail-closed Cargo dependency-boundary admission

repository.name: ic-storage
repository.description: Governed stable collections for Internet Computer applications using IC Memory allocation handles.

issue.body:
IC Storage main a7ed957a65ff46b72d67198f1e9eb0f5b10a4bf3 (0.3.1) selects Shared eb04376623a8995b2301d7cc80723a2a3f3e5b8e in tools/dependency-boundaries/.shared-tooling.snapshot. Its checker bytes match the Shared PR #257 proposal.

A bounded Cargo substitute returning {} makes that checker report success. This is malformed-observation admission, not a claim that real Cargo normally emits invalid metadata. The original pipeline can also print success before discovering a child failure. Require successful Cargo completion and a complete workspace projection rather than treating missing fields as an empty set.

Shared's uncommitted 0.20 adaptation validates policy before dispatch, successful normal child completion, metadata format/workspace identity, complete nonempty member/package coverage and dependency records. Focused malformed/failed/signalled observations and actual locked offline Cargo fixtures pass, including canonical renamed normal/build/dev/target-specific dependencies and unchanged lockfile. No product compilation or fetching was performed. Producer review: https://github.com/dragginzgame/shared-tooling/pull/257 .

After a supplying Shared revision is committed and reviewed, refresh only this nested boundary snapshot through the canonical exporter. Preserve consumer policy and check-storage-boundary wiring. Verify the new snapshot, actual Storage metadata/policy and boundary rejection before accepting adoption. Do not patch vendored bytes or select a dirty upstream checkout. No normal sibling working checkout was changed for this finding.
